compute_triangular_number: compute the number of non-negative integral solutions to B + C <= N+1 using the triangular number formula
run_f_gold: run f_gold with an integer n to get the count of non-negative integral solutions
test_f_gold: test f_gold against a filled implementation using the provided parameter sets
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to support larger integer inputs without floating point division
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that calculates triangular numbers for a given n
